title: Emerald Square Ear Cuff
descriptionHtml:
One green square, no piercing needed. An ear cuff of slim polished gold wire that slides onto the middle ridge of the ear, carrying one square princess cut emerald green stone in four claws. Wear it alone or with the Crystal Pear Ear Cuff above it.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Crystal Pear Ear Cuff on the same ear.

Details

  • Style: Ear cuff, no piercing needed
  • Size: Approximately 12mm across
  • Stone: One square princess cut emerald green cubic zirconia, approximately 5mm, in four claws
  • Fit: Slides onto the middle ridge of the ear
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
